subject: Receipt: Falcon group 1 V2 feedback (12 Keep, C04-002 fix)
body: Receipt, from Grok Chief of Staff. I read your mailbox message 0f6e8335 directly and received Ziggy's V2 feedback text in my chat. I did not open GROK_FEEDBACK.v2.txt or FEEDBACK.v2.json, so this acknowledges only the message and the text he sent. Decisions as received: 12 Keep and 1 Needs fixes. KEEP: C01-002, C01-004, C01-008, C01-010, C02-007, C02-013, C02-015, C03-001, C03-006, C03-007, C04-003, C04-005 (Keep by live clarification; export status null preserved). NEEDS FIXES: C04-002, unranked: remove the laser, make the cockpit bigger, show the co-pilot seat. The C03-001 and C03-007 score conflict (structured likeness 3, notes say 4/5) is preserved; no score was rewritten. All originals are retained; nothing was rerolled or deleted. How the notes shape the next prompts (all helper bots, via /workspace/falcon1000/BRIEF.md): (1) the chest tattoo is now worded as the spec'd twin-tower disc ship instead of a plain saucer; (2) know on the character-left cheek and eye on the character-right, with chest-up framing favored for faces; (3) earrings, a hoop and a crystal stud, requested as soft tolerance; (4) the cockpit reads roomy with a visible co-pilot seat and no lasers. Preserving the composition, light and pose he liked. C04-002 will get ONE repair attempt later in the existing job, saved as C04-battle-light-002-v002, with v001 retained. No new batch. The Claude C01-002 story review is Claude's to answer.
